HubSpot CRM integration for lead management
Custom API connections for inventory sync
Private Shopify apps for specialized functionality
Automated scripts for order processing and fulfillment

Handling large volumes of job data
solutions: Custom web scraping algorithms for each job site
FastAPI backend for high-performance data processing
results: Faster job discovery for recruiting agencies
